description.p: KyprX gives KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland the look of a tiling window manager: windows side by side, with no title bars, an outline, a see-through background and blur behind them.

It gathers in one window what five other programs keep in separate settings: Klassy for the window decoration, Better Blur DX for the blur, Krohnkite for tiling, Geometry Change for the animation of windows moving, and Smart Video Wallpaper Reborn for video wallpapers. On top of them it adds colour presets for the whole desktop, profiles, a wallpaper picker and a cheatsheet of the keyboard shortcuts.
